metadata.reviewer: Independent contextual same-family agent, not human gold or cross-family review
metadata.blinding: Read only retained blind cases, rubric, responses and binding. No new arm map, raw live receipts, summary, timing or costs read; no arm assignment inferred.
metadata.prior_exposure: Prior experiments and their outputs, current fixture source review and new contract/code preflight were known. The retained corpus is diagnostic, not heldout; the fresh cohort must be reported separately.
metadata.rule: Unchanged strict clause-level rubric, exact assertion target, supported-neighbor protection, unchanged mechanical errors. Later correct language cannot repair an unsupported categorical clause.

field_definitions.core_concern_supported: The exact target has the identified frozen material concern; other finding defects are scored separately.
field_definitions.citations_relevant: Original citations address the proposition; relevance does not warrant a spurious criticism.
field_definitions.basis_overstates_evidence: Typed basis or prose asserts a contradiction/disproof not established by sources.
field_definitions.unsupported_replacement: Unsupported proposed correction or auxiliary factual clause.
field_definitions.concern_ids: Frozen concerns addressed by the core; only fully valid findings contribute coverage.
field_definitions.covered_concern_ids: Unique fully valid concern findings in mechanically valid output, never mechanical-error prose.
field_definitions.missed_concern_ids: Frozen concerns not covered by fully valid findings, separate from valid abstention.
field_definitions.semantic_pass: Allowed mechanically valid action, complete fully valid concern coverage and no spurious or unsupported findings.

ambiguous_items.primary: Strict recorded-versus-occurred interpretation rejects the dropped qualification.
ambiguous_items.alternative: Treat the web-editor channel as a closed world for actual writes. The two mechanically valid outputs could pass; the mechanical error still receives no coverage or semantic pass.

artifact_notes: The unchanged copied rubric mentions twelve pairs/twenty-four cases from its original corpus. This retained subset contains eight cases/four matched pairs; that stale descriptive cardinality is not used for scoring.
